meta.status: DRAFT: preliminary static proposal, MUST be confirmed by measured gcov vectors (task-2/task-3)
meta.selection_rule: greedy set-cover on activation vectors + family coverage; ieee/ and builtins/ mandatory

reduction_rule_vincolante.i: a cell is removable only if its bambu function coverage is null or already covered (gcov, task-2/3)
reduction_rule_vincolante.ii: and its IR is fingerprint-identical to a kept cell (task-6, 04-cross-compiler-ir-matrix.md)
reduction_rule_vincolante.iii: and every oracle test (abort/exit, also via #include) stays EXECUTED with the RTL testbench in at least one kept cell (invariant verified by this script)

oracle_ledger.note: counts verified with grep over the tree, 2026-11-07; the 418/443 figure of the plan was not reproduced

clang-4.0_eg_O0.rationale: only expose-globals cell on the oldest frontend: globals/mem targets + ieee; one -O only; trio forced (S26 latest-row rule)

clang-6.0_bambu_O0.rationale: control-flow + GNU-extension cover on mid frontend; cheap -O0; trio forced (S26 latest-row rule)

clang-7_bambu_O1.rationale: float/softfloat path (O1 keeps fp ops non-inlined); unique -O1 slot

clang-11_bambu_O2.rationale: memory-inference/bit-ops heavy at -O2 (loop opts, strength reduction)

clang-16_eg_ext_pipelined_O2.rationale: reference CI cell: widest static cover + large stress tests

clang-19_eg_ext_pipelined_O3.rationale: newest frontend + aggressive -O3 IR shapes; small budgeted mix

clang-16_pretty_print_O0.rationale: C code writer round-trip: structs/fp/string-heavy (pretty-print recompile checks)

clang-16_vhdl_O0.rationale: VHDL writer exercises same IR; control/float variety only
